claims: Artemis II traveled at speeds up to approximately 25,000 mph during critical phases of its mission.
Artemis II's peak speed of approximately 25,000 mph was achieved during the trans-lunar injection (TLI) burn to leave Earth.
Artemis II's peak speed of approximately 25,000 mph was achieved during the high-speed re-entry into Earth's atmosphere.
Artemis II's SLS rocket reached over 17,000 mph to achieve orbit.
Artemis II's spacecraft traveled at roughly 24,500–25,000 mph to leave Earth's orbit during translunar injection (TLI).
Artemis II's Orion capsule reached speeds of around 24,000 to 25,000 mph when re-entering the atmosphere.
Artemis II's Orion capsule reached about Mach 32 when re-entering the atmosphere.
Artemis II's Orion capsule re-entry created temperatures up to 5,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
Artemis II used a free return trajectory.
Artemis II's free return trajectory allowed the spacecraft to use the moon's gravity for a return trip.
Artemis II had a final splashdown speed of about 19 mph.
